chunks: From him, from al-‘Abbās ibn Ma‘rūf, from Ṣafwān, from Ṣāliḥ al-Naylī, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ‘Umayr, who said:
I said to Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام: May I perform salat (prayer) on a shādhakūnah when janabah has affected it? He said: There is no harm.

key_terms.الْجَنَابَةُ: the state of major ritual impurity
key_terms.شَاذَكُونَةٍ: a type of mat or cloth spread on which one may sit or pray
key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) on a shādhakūnah affected by janabah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about performing salat (prayer) on a shādhakūnah that has been affected by janabah. Imam Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام states that there is no problem with praying on it, indicating permissibility in this case.
